svg.title: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, as rpi-virt-fw models it
svg.desc: Board block diagram. The BCM2711 in the centre with its controller ports on the edges. Left: the SPI NOR flash on SPI0; the PMICs at 0x1E and 0x1B and the FXL6408 expander on I2C bus 8; LPDDR4 on the SDRAM controller. Right: the BCM54213PE PHY on GENET's MDIO bus; the VL805 xHCI controller and the VIA hub behind the PCIe root complex; the two HDMI outputs. Bottom: the microSD slot on EMMC2, the WiFi and Bluetooth module on the legacy EMMC, the USB-C port on DWC2, the 40-pin header on UART0 and BSC0, the camera and display connectors on BSC0. Every part carries the name of its spec in specs/, and every wire the parent link it draws.
